title: GameGraph
responsibility: Edit checkpoint dependencies and graph positions while showing eligibility and completed progress.

inputs.name: GameGraph.checkpoints
inputs.description: Authoritative checkpoint nodes and prerequisite relationships for this view.

inputs.name: GameGraph.run
inputs.description: Current deterministic tick, game state, completed checkpoints, events and execution trace.

inputs.name: GameGraph.selected
inputs.description: Identity of the checkpoint currently selected in the graph.

inputs.name: GameGraph.select
inputs.description: Callback selecting the requested view or checkpoint identity without saving the document.

inputs.name: GameGraph.change
inputs.description: Callback publishing the edited checkpoint, view patch or graph node list to its owner.

inputs.name: GameGraph.readonly
inputs.description: Disable editing and generation for historical or otherwise immutable views.

outputs.name: GameGraph
outputs.description: Edit checkpoint dependencies and graph positions while showing eligibility and completed progress. Renders reactive UI and publishes edits through its callbacks.
